Reshape a data.table from long to wide format

Source: R/incucyte_utils.R
cast_to_wide.Rd

This function utilizes the powerful dcast function from the data.table package to pivot data. It turns unique values from a specified column into new columns in the output data.table.

Usage

cast_to_wide(long_data, id_vars, col_var, val_var)

Arguments

long_data

data.table; A data.table in long format.

id_vars

character vector; Column names that uniquely identify each row (e.g. c("CellLineName", "range")).

col_var

character; The column whose unique values will become the new column headers (e.g., "treatment").

val_var

character; The column whose values will fill the cells (e.g., "rate").

Value

A new data.table in wide format.
